news.headline: Abivax Earnings Imminent as Analysts Revise Forecasts Ahead of H1 2026 Call
news.summary: Ahead of Abivax's H1 2026 results (due after market close on September 21), analysts covering the stock revised their forecasts, with consensus pointing to a roughly $1.08 per-share loss and minimal revenue as the company remains pre-commercial.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $101, Keeps Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its Abivax price target from $71 to $101 while reiterating an Overweight rating, part of a broader wave of bullish sell-side re-ratings ahead of the H1 2026 earnings call.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Abivax at Buy, Sees Obefazimod as 'Multiblockbuster'
news.summary: Goldman Sachs started coverage with a Buy rating and $155 price target, modeling roughly €4B peak UC sales and €3.5B in Crohn's disease for obefazimod; the move came alongside a regulatory filing showing Bank of America had crossed the 5% ownership threshold in Abivax, underscoring rising institutional accumulation.

news.headline: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.summary: STAT examines why a widely-expected buyout of Abivax hasn't materialized despite a red-hot biotech M&A market, noting the company's $920M July capital raise now lets it pursue a solo US commercial launch of obefazimod instead of relying on a Big Pharma partner.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax reported constructive FDA feedback that aligned the agency and company on the planned NDA content and format for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, keeping the company on track for a late-Q4 2026 NDA submission.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of Upsized $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed a public offering of 7.36 million ADSs at $125 each (underwriters' overallotment fully exercised), raising about $920M in gross proceeds earmarked to fund a potential US commercial launch of obefazimod and extend its cash runway into 2029.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: First financial and pipeline update since the $920M July capital raise and the positive July FDA pre-NDA meeting; watch for commentary on NDA-readiness spend, cash runway, and US commercial build-out plans.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod NDA submission to FDA (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Company reaffirmed it remains on track to submit its first NDA, following FDA alignment on submission content/format reached at the July 2026 pre-NDA meeting.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction readout
catalysts.detail: 12-week induction data from the Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease; guidance has shifted out from an earlier expectation of late 2026 to mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Potential M&A / takeover of Abivax
catalysts.detail: Recurring speculation about acquisition interest — first Eli Lilly (denied by CEO, January 2026), then AstraZeneca (denied, March 2026) — continues to shadow the stock; the $920M raise gives Abivax a credible go-it-alone path if no deal emerges.

pulse: Abivax heads into its H1 2026 results (after the close on September 21) on a wave of bullish sell-side re-ratings — Goldman Sachs initiated at Buy ($155 PT) and Morgan Stanley lifted its target to $101 — alongside disclosure that Bank of America has built a >5% stake. The company is fully funded into 2029 after closing a $920M offering and remains on track for a late-Q4 2026 FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis following a positive pre-NDA meeting, even as persistent (and repeatedly denied) Eli Lilly/AstraZeneca takeover speculation continues to swirl around the stock.
